identity: A workbook with a cell grid, column and row headers, a formula field, sheet tabs, controls, and a status readout.

scenarios.name: fillhandle
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row and populated records, with a short numeric or formula pattern in the seed cells and blank cells where the pattern needs to continue. The formula field and status readout are visible; menus and dialogs are closed.
never: The unfinished destination cells already contain the completed pattern.
A fill popup is open.
Filled cells appear outside the grid.
A conditional-formatting dialog is open.

arrangements.text: The formula field sits above the grid, the sheet tabs sit below it, and the status readout runs along the bottom.
The formula field sits beside the top of the grid, with the sheet tabs and status readout beneath the grid.

scenarios.name: range
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row and populated records in a grid of cells. The requested rectangle is not yet the active selection; the formula field and status readout are visible, and menus and dialogs are closed.
never: The requested rectangle is already selected.
A range picker popup is open.
The selection extends beyond the grid.
A conditional-formatting dialog is open.

arrangements.text: The formula field sits above the grid, the sheet tabs sit below it, and the status readout runs along the bottom.
The formula field sits beside the top of the grid, while the sheet tabs and status readout sit beneath it.

scenarios.name: formula
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row and populated records, with a target cell awaiting the requested formula. A formula field sits by the grid, and the status readout is visible; menus and dialogs are closed.
never: The target cell already contains the requested formula.
A formula suggestion popup is open.
The target cell displays the completed formula's result.
A conditional-formatting dialog is open.

arrangements.text: The formula field runs above the grid, with the sheet tabs and status readout below.
The formula field sits to the right of the grid's top edge, and the sheet tabs and status readout sit below the grid.

scenarios.name: sort
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row above populated records in their starting order. Column headers, the formula field, sheet tabs, and status readout are visible; the sort menu is closed.
never: The requested sort has already reordered the records.
A sort menu is open.
Only one column's cells have moved while the rest of each record stayed in place.
The header row has moved into the data rows.

arrangements.text: Column headers sit directly above the records, the formula field sits above the grid, and the sheet tabs and status readout sit below.
Column headers sit directly above the records, the formula field sits beside the grid's top edge, and the status readout sits beneath the sheet tabs.

scenarios.name: filter
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row and all starting records, including the categorical values in the column to filter. Column headers, the formula field, sheet tabs, and status readout are visible; the filter menu is closed.
never: Records outside the requested category are already hidden.
A filter menu is open.
A category option list is open.
Filtered records appear in a separate results panel.

arrangements.text: Column headers sit above the records, the formula field sits above the grid, and the sheet tabs and status readout sit below.
Column headers sit above the records, the formula field sits beside the grid's top edge, and the status readout sits below the sheet tabs.

scenarios.name: condfmt
scenarios.screen: The sheet shows a header row and populated records, with a conditional-formatting control near the grid. No new comparison rule or fill is applied, and the rule dialog is closed.
never: The conditional-formatting dialog is already open.
The requested fill is already applied to matching cells.
A color palette is open.
A separate legend of matching values is displayed.

arrangements.text: The conditional-formatting control sits above the grid beside the formula field, with the sheet tabs and status readout below.
The conditional-formatting control sits beside the grid, while the formula field runs above it and the sheet tabs and status readout sit below.
